description: This PHP source file defines a class EmailManViewList that extends ViewList, responsible for managing the email marketing list view in SuiteCRM. It includes methods for pre-display processing, module title generation, list view preparation, and processing the list view with additional HTML form elements for email delivery actions.

classes.name: EmailManViewList
classes.description: A class extending ViewList to manage the listing and actions for email campaigns within SuiteCRM, including access control and UI rendering.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Performs access control check for admin privileges and initializes the ListViewSmarty object for rendering the list view.

methods.name: _getModuleTitleParams
methods.description: Returns the module title parameters with links, typically for display in the UI header.

methods.name: listViewPrepare
methods.description: Prepares the list view, disables the title display, and renders the module title.

methods.name: listViewProcess
methods.description: Processes the list view, including rendering an HTML form with action buttons for sending queued emails.
